title: Rafael and the Ember
author: Cyrus Hartwell
blurb: Xanthe Fairweather, the youngest member of a dying guild, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
